notes.title: Development Update #5 New Buildings and More
notes.content: [h3]Development Update #5 New Buildings and More[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/fcdee9d619f8a312e06db1373c9681bc1bde5c9f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It has been a while since we last posted an update here on Steam. If you want to follow our game more closely please join our discord at the bottom of the page for almost daily updates. Since the last update we have been hard at work making changes to the towns and many of the 3d models. The British and Spanish towns have been largely redone.[/p][p][/p][h3]British Towns[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/01eb060a5b3a02bd70a7fb5106a8e29d9a98e56b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The British houses were remodeled with new different roofs and structures that are 1-3 stories tall. We also added details in the towns such as barrels, crates and bags of flour. We think these changes have given the British towns a more unique style and also makes them more lived in.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/20ba768b23bc1b905906218ff5179aaed6509b24.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Spanish Towns[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/42b6d51bf1bb64a277af2a367156c1e70061617f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Spanish Towns have also been overhauled. We completely remodeled all of the buildings to fit more of the Spanish colonial architecture. The buildings are a mix of white, sienna, and tan colors. They have also been populated with details and red brick grounds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/31022d52b1250c30b4017fac65579a4c8e730978.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Code Updates[/h3][p][/p][p]Our multiplayer code is almost completely finished in terms of movement, physics and chunking the world. The inventory system is complete and we are currently rigging animations to each item the player can hold.[/p]

tags.feature: The British houses were remodeled with new different roofs and structures that are 1-3 stories tall. We also added details in the towns such as barrels, crates and bags of flour. We think these changes have given the British towns a more unique style and also makes them more lived in.

The Spanish Towns have also been overhauled. We completely remodeled all of the buildings to fit more of the Spanish colonial architecture. The buildings are a mix of white, sienna, and tan colors. They have also been populated with details and red brick grounds.

Our multiplayer code is almost completely finished in terms of movement, physics and chunking the world. The inventory system is complete and we are currently rigging animations to each item the player can hold.

notes.title: Weekly Update #3 Stone Buildings and World Changes
notes.content: [h3][b]Weekly Update #3 Stone Buildings and World Changes[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/7a8060e7399cd6d4e5631c34d1b4ffad46dd5bf5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]More progress this week! We decided to add stone building structures to give players another way to upgrade their base. Paths are also slowly being added to connect lootzones on the islands. Lastly we have been working on making the forts which player's can raid more menacing.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Stone Structures[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/a5a9464f44ebfc12c23cda579d2f0cd356586737.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We added stone walls, stone triangles, stone floors, stone ceilings, reinforced doors, and wooden roofs. All of these except the wood roof will serve as building upgrades to player buildable houses. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Paths between Loot zones[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/c5799c293c16369f08c4163f923ab7f7276e0e2d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]These paths with connect loot zones on most islands. This will function to connect the islands so players have more defined ways to move around. Also the loot zones felt "lonely" not being connected. The hope is that these paths with also funnel player interaction.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Forts[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/1ec179020d29dcea48393df1ea7f5e816fdab12a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Just working on making them look larger and grander.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Server Updates[/b][/h3][p]Our server architect is almost complete connect the server to the client. Soon we will have joinable servers on our new server software supporting 250 players+. The last server software was incapable of supporting our intended player count per server.[/p]

notes.title: Weekly Update #2 Caves and Skeletons
notes.content: [h1]Weekly Development Update #2[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/90b5760875c77c67d30de0318213e3d896bad9a2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This weeks development update will be shorter than previous. Our efforts have been focused on server code but we did add other visual assets. Our 3d Modeler has added caves and skeletons. [/p][h2]Caves[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/6956c0f9e6277e4b8fc608b5263a9b6619ccd3a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We implemented caves to the main world, which can be found on the westward chain of islands. These caves will hold gold ore for players to farm. Loot such as weapons. blueprints, and resources can be found inside. The caves will also have the same skeletons that spawn on skull island.[/p][p][/p][h2]Skeletons[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/430745891630e78cd014f176f01a35c08678208c.png"][/img][/p][p]Skeletons will function as another faction similar to the Redcoats or Spanish. They will occur within caves and on Skull island. Their attire shows they were former British Redcoats. Due to their anatomy and them being completely bone, bullets may not work well.[/p][p][/p][h2]Server Code[/h2][p]Our server architect has continued to work without sleep to finish the server side physics. This has led to the completion of mapping the terrain so our physics controller collides with the terrain. This was the last of the server side physics. This means we can now work on other core game features such as resource collection and projectile systems.[/p]
